status: Locked follow-up plan after discovery; not retrospective preregistration or independent validation
direction: Higher frozen score associated with greater wall-thickness flag prevalence
primary_comparison: Both factors added to clinical, normalized waveform, ordinary covariance, context and frozen ResNet score
secondary_comparisons: Each factor separately; penalized logistic and fixed nonlinear reference
primary_metric: Paired AUROC difference; Brier and average precision supportive

bootstrap.interval: paired percentile 95%, conditional on fitted models

calibration: Sigmoid fit on original training-monitor patients only
threshold: 0.20 exploratory decision probability; no clinical threshold claim
subgroups: Recorded sex, age <65/65+, QRS <120/120+ ms, ventricular rate <60/60-100/>100, acquisition-year halves defined by fitting median, setting; no outcome-driven merging
selection: No factor, sign, loading, threshold, model or subgroup selection from new results
sealed: No official test waveform, outcomes or predictions accessed
limitations: Original encoder selected on official validation
Training embedding risk scores are in-sample for the supervised encoder
No validated raw-voltage or QRS axis estimates
